about: Specular occlusion (the bake raises roughness and mutes metalness in occluded crevices) is for NEW pieces only - the owner, 2026-11-17: "New pieces only". Every piece named here was built or scripted before that day: it bakes as before, byte for byte, unless its script asks for it (rbx.Asset(..., spec_occlusion=1.0)). Kit fixtures (_selftest*, _probe*) are old too. A game version (<name>_game) follows its master. Never add a new piece here.
